activities.text: Ran the schedule audit — Saturday, calendar empty, movie night tonight is the whole ballgame
Picked today's look — cozy movie-night sweater and a popcorn bowl, ready for hosting duty
Sent Angie's morning text — free all day until six, sunny and cold here, drizzle in Ottawa
Morning briefing delivered — no classes, two old Contracts readings flagged, movie night at six
Fixed my voice record — old British man, Dignified Piano — and set up the root backup repo, then retired the old reboot stack
Wall tablet stuck in dark mode at 9:42 — force-push dragged it into the light, checking tomorrow if it sticks
Out and back on the morning run — party supplies and dessert sorted, home by 10:43
Wired up Thunder Bay Home Assistant — 138 entities — and cracked TV volume: step commands work, percentages are lying
Added the four new Con Law cases to Tasks with Alford's links — Dominion, RJR 1995 not 1994, McNeil, Westendorp
The '11%' old cartridge printed 143 pages unfaded — the ink gauge is fiction, Tariel's word is ground truth
Dessert done — glazed and powdered donuts — headcount hit 11, pizza plan grew and the coupon codes all failed
Briefed R v Harrison and filed it in the vault — Grant's companion case, cocaine excluded, acquittal entered
Doors open — movie night, Blood Quantum on the screen, full house of homies, six larges via the BOGO deal
Evening wrap — rewrote the house to match the day as it actually happened, then hammock time
